## Person
Prince Dixit is a Delhi, India-based professional whose portfolio combines e-commerce operations, digital marketing, SEO, website/app troubleshooting, business automation and practical software experiments.

## Core capabilities
E-commerce operations; product and SKU workflows; inventory and order operations; supplier and purchasing workflows; Google Sheets; Google Apps Script; JavaScript; HTML/CSS; SEO and on-page optimization; digital marketing; Meta Ads; business automation; AI-assisted interfaces.

## Featured builds
- Multybyte Purchase System — product/SKU, supplier, purchasing, image synchronization and spreadsheet automation.
- Nova — conversational AI interface embedded in the portfolio.
- EyeNav / Doc — Android accessibility and voice-first assistant experiments.
- Prince.OS — the portfolio system itself, including responsive UI, themes, navigation, SEO and Nova.
